craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of stated proof — design inference through lacunae; gaps sung as gaps; FIRST VERSE of the work sets the house voice (terminal doctrine words; owner verdict required). Function-yoking; never-from-matter hammer. Rejected: (a) mere→bare → killed: mere denies sufficiency. Read aloud: THERE-is, IN-func-tion-YOK-ing … NEV-er FROM-mere-MATT-er.

lines: There is, in function-yoking, among bodies and worlds,
this distinct array — never from mere matter.

reads_against.argmap: Can matter arrange? → Arrangement in function-fit things cannot come from matter alone.
c1_essence: Bodies bespeak a conscious maker, like pots: the design inference stated through lacunae (vv1-2).
Variety marks wisdom; matter can't arrange; makers proved prove the Lord — answering neither-potter-nor-Lord with conscious-only pervasion shown (vv5-9).
